title: Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. translated_title: 先锐化，再适配：面向测试时强化学习的无数据入口状态锐化方法
translated_abstract: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）利用语言模型自身样本导出的监督信号，在无标注测试问题上对模型进行适配。这使得检查点的“入口状态”至关重要：一个分布弥散的策略会产生更嘈杂的自我监督，并可能在有限的适配预算中消耗大量步骤仅仅用于集中概率质量，之后才能可靠地表达其本已具备的能力。我们提出“入口状态锐化”：在TTRL之前先进行无数据训练，将一个通用检查点准备到后续无标签适配能够更高效利用的状态。这一想法并不依赖于某一种特定的训练方案；不同的无数据目标函数可以将同一个基础模型移动到不同的入口状态。在由Qwen3-4B派生的五个无数据检查点上，并在相同的15步TTRL协议下进行评估，入口策略熵对端点转换效率（从可靠性到可达性……）具有很强的排序指示作用。
tldr: 提出在测试时强化学习（TTRL）之前先进行无数据的“入口状态锐化”训练，使模型以熵更低、分布更集中的状态进入适配阶段，从而显著提升无标签测试时适配的效率与可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes "entry-state sharpening"—data-free training before test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) that moves a checkpoint to a sharper, lower-entropy entry state, enabling subsequent label-free test-time adaptation to more reliably and efficiently express the model's existing capabilities.
